test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The radius of a cylinder is 16(2)/(3)\% more than the radius of a hemisphere. The height of the cylinder is 21 cm. Find the volume of the hemisphere if the volume of the cylinder is equal to the volume of another sphere having radius 7 cm. (Calculate to two decimal places; use pi = frac{{22}}{7})
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Radius** (Cylinder : Hemisphere) = (100 + 16 2/3) : 100 = 7 : 6

Volume of **Cylinder** = Volume of **Sphere** ⇒ π × R꜀yₗ² × 21 = 4/3 × π × 7³

R꜀yₗ² = (4 × 343) ÷ (3 × 21) = 196/9 ⇒ R꜀yₗ = 14/3 cm

Since 7 units = 14/3, then 6 units (Rₕₑₘ) = (14/3 ÷ 7) × 6 = 4 cm

Volume of **Hemisphere** = 2/3 × 22/7 × 4³ = 2816/21 ≈ 134.10 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 134.10 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92d4597d3f827e41f32a6cbcb7716b9e7a5adef7e0f10a37993a46a523d0fb41.png] 

**Given:**

⇒ **Height of cylinder** (H) = 21 cm

⇒ **Radius of sphere** (Rₛ) = 7 cm

⇒ R꜀yₗ = Rₕₑₘ × (1 + 16 2/3%) = Rₕₑₘ × (1 + 1/6) = 7/6 × Rₕₑₘ

**Formula Used:**

⇒ **Volume of Cylinder** = πR²H

⇒ **Volume of Sphere** = 4/3 πR³

⇒ **Volume of Hemisphere** = 2/3 πR³

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume of Cylinder = Volume of Sphere

⇒ π × R꜀yₗ² × 21 = 4/3 × π × 7³

⇒ R꜀yₗ² × 21 = 4/3 × 343

⇒ R꜀yₗ² = (4 × 343) ÷ (3 × 21) = 1372 ÷ 63 = 196/9

⇒ R꜀yₗ = √(196/9) = 14/3 cm

⇒ Rₕₑₘ = 6/7 × R꜀yₗ = 6/7 × 14/3 = 4 cm

⇒ Volume of Hemisphere = 2/3 × 22/7 × 4³

⇒ Volume of Hemisphere = (2 × 22 × 64) ÷ (3 × 7) = 2816 ÷ 21 ≈ 134.0952 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 134.10 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Three-Dimensional Shapes

The volume of a **sphere** is 4/3 πr³, while a **hemisphere** is exactly half of that, 2/3 πr³.

Surface Area of Hemisphere

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πr² and Total Surface Area (TSA) = 3πr².

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

16 2/3% is a standard fraction equal to 1/6. Increasing a value by 16 2/3% is equivalent to multiplying by (1 + 1/6) = 7/6.</p
